primary_metric_definition: Pooled ROC AUC over all VALIDATE cells (window, outcome Up/Down, second 0..299 of the window); label = any of GF/XM/DS has an on-chain BUY OrderFilled (taker or maker role) on that outcome token with block timestamp in that second; score = frozen point-in-time model using only public data available before the second (Binance 1-s closes of second <= s-2, other traders' prints <= s-1, listing metadata), no own-state features.

split.note: BUILD may be extended back in time in later iterations

hypotheses.description: Fixed-size BUY limit orders priced at the current best ask; unfilled remainder rests at that price
hypotheses.verdict: supported

hypotheses.description: Independent resting bids (inventory-balanced MM around a fair value)
hypotheses.verdict: open: 62% of maker fill events come from pure resting orders whose placement time is unobserved

hypotheses.description: Buys outcome o right after a Binance move toward o (1-3 s)
hypotheses.verdict: supported as the main timing signal; weak alone

hypotheses.description: Buy when Binance FV - ask > theta
hypotheses.verdict: rejected as trigger

hypotheses.description: Strike = 60-s TWAP before the open (vs open price)
hypotheses.verdict: TWAP strike supported

hypotheses.description: Three wallets are parallel instances on the same signal
hypotheses.verdict: supported

hypotheses.description: LightGBM on Binance-only PIT features, BUILD 14 days
hypotheses.verdict: presence AUC 0.805

hypotheses.family: behaviour cloning, spot + others' tape PIT
hypotheses.description: LightGBM on Binance + other traders' tape PIT features (cluster prints and prints against the cluster removed), BUILD = windows with tapes 10-09..16
hypotheses.verdict: best: presence AUC 0.892 (taker 0.893, maker 0.867); ~0.06 from 1-2 s race co-occurrence; side 66% < 80%; PnL corr 0.31 < 0.5

hypotheses.description: Does the bot act before public signals?
hypotheses.verdict: acts after Binance moves (2-3 s before block ts); faster feeds (Binance futures, Coinbase) untested

hypotheses.description: Pure resting orders are 'buy at the ask' orders that lost the race to a competing taker
hypotheses.verdict: supported: one trigger and one order type for both roles

hypotheses.description: Spot+tape model plus cluster window inventory up to s-1
hypotheses.verdict: small gain (+0.014); reported as secondary only

hypotheses.description: Side = the outcome the cluster holds less of in the window
hypotheses.verdict: rejected

hypotheses.description: Taker orders split by the visible 3-s Binance move (<0.5 bp = quiet)
hypotheses.verdict: supported: two regimes, one order type; quiet volume is rebate-driven with a weak side signal

hypotheses.description: Side vs FUTURE Binance moves when the past (incl. non-PIT seconds) is flat
hypotheses.verdict: supported: the bot has a weak signal that leads Binance spot

hypotheses.description: ms price moves and aggressor-signed volume before the order
hypotheses.verdict: rejected as the missing signal: information horizon ends ~1 s before the block; OFI weaker than price

hypotheses.family: alternative reference feed: Binance USD-M futures
hypotheses.description: Futures aggTrades (2026-10-15, BUILD) moves before the order
hypotheses.verdict: supported: futures features raise side accuracy 66.4% -> 69.8% (taker 66.7% -> 70.7%) on VALIDATE (BUILD 4 days); not yet in the frozen rule

hypotheses.description: LightGBM side classifier on one-sided seconds (spot, tape, own state)
hypotheses.verdict: 66.8%; +own state 67.3%; ceiling with non-PIT klines 68.0%

hypotheses.description: Quiet orders are halves of simultaneous Up+Down pairs
hypotheses.verdict: rejected (bursty both-sided activity, not pairs)

hypotheses.description: Cluster taker prints have the bot's fixed order sizes {30, 50, 60}; score = size rule + cell p
hypotheses.verdict: supported: selection AUC 0.837 >= 0.80; recall at the pre-registered flag 31% < 50%

hypotheses.family: alternative reference feed: Binance USD-M futures in the frozen rule
hypotheses.description: PIT futures aggTrades features (moves 0.25-10 s, OFI, since-last-print move, basis-adjusted futures fair value) in presence and side models
hypotheses.verdict: supported: presence 0.896 -> 0.904, side 67.1% -> 70.3%

hypotheses.family: information wall test (anticipation beyond public PIT data)
hypotheses.description: Bot side vs our best PIT side model in predicting FUTURE Binance futures moves when Binance futures and spot were flat up to the horizon
hypotheses.verdict: with Binance-only features the bot anticipates futures (z=17.6 vs our 2.3); with OKX+Bybit features most of it is explained (z 12.5 vs ours 12.6): cross-venue information, not a private feed; small residual remains

hypotheses.family: other perpetual venues (OKX swap, Bybit perp)
hypotheses.description: Bot side vs OKX / Bybit moves when Binance is flat
hypotheses.verdict: supported: Binance-flat side agreement 56% (OKX) / 60% (Bybit); 75-82% when the venue moved >= 0.5 bp

hypotheses.description: Presence + side models with Binance futures, OKX swap, Bybit perp (and in 'six': Binance spot aggTrades, Bybit spot, OKX spot) and composites (mean / largest venue move)
hypotheses.verdict: supported: the bot fires on whichever venue moves first; best rule

hypotheses.family: Kraken XBT/USD (Chainlink input; REST paged by time)
hypotheses.description: Does Kraken explain the side in seconds when none of the six archived series moved (<= 0.1 bp over the PIT 3 s)?
hypotheses.verdict: rejected: 49.9% agreement in no-move seconds (6 sampled VALIDATE hours)

hypotheses.family: sizing rule v3 (full orders + partial fills)
hypotheses.description: Size classes decoded on BUILD: full orders {30,50,60,100}, partial taker fills {5,...,25}; flag = full OR (partial AND p >= 0.30)
hypotheses.verdict: selection target met on VALIDATE (AUC 0.865, recall 67.6% at lift 4.6); co-occurrence baseline 0.852

hypotheses.description: Side = sign of the largest 2-s move among the six reference series (PIT); presence trigger = move toward o >= x bp with ask in [0.12, 0.88]
hypotheses.verdict: supported: 69.1% side on all one-sided seconds, 80.4% on the 46% with a >= 0.5 bp move; presence trigger recall 33% at lift 3.0
